question: Which saturated salt solution set the humidity at which single crystals were most frequent?
expect: sodium bromide: single crystals become more frequent at RH about 59%, which saturated NaBr maintained (LiCl 11%, MgCl2 33%) (Experimental Setup; Results)
rendered: At RH ≈ 59%, single crystals became more frequent. The saturated solution of sodium bromide was employed to maintain the relative humidity in the capped glass container at 59%.
